# Production robots for www.riamoneytransfer.com (flipped at domain cutover —
# while this site was only reachable at rps-3.netlify.app behind the legacy
# proxy, everything was disallowed to avoid duplicate indexing).
# /sitemap.xml is the root sitemap index (app/(sitemap)/sitemap.xml) listing
# the pages, blog and per-locale rates sitemaps.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
# Next.js appends ?_rsc=<hash> to React Server Component prefetch requests.
# These are duplicates of the real page URLs and must not be crawled/indexed.
Disallow: /*?_rsc=

# Meta's AI-training crawler ("train foundation AI models or improve products
# by indexing content directly") — blocked site-wide. Token per Meta's docs:
# https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/webmasters/web-crawlers/
# Scoped to this token only: facebookexternalhit (link previews) and Meta's
# other crawlers match their own tokens / the * group and are unaffected.
User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://www.riamoneytransfer.com/sitemap.xml
